subject: Tri-party co-sell sync: runbook, rehearsal slots, and fallback lanes
messages:
From: Ankit Sharma <ankit@cloudbridge.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Tri-party demo — proposed windows + agenda attached

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for taking this forward. CloudBridge (SI) + AWS partner team want to run a joint co-sell demo that showcases Redwood Dedicated + our orchestration around Nebula (their infra layer). We need a tri-party window where the AWS SI lead, CloudBridge PMs, and a Redwood solutions engineer are all present.

High-level asks:
- 45 minute technical demo + 15 minute Q&A
- 30 minute rehearsal 48 hours before the demo with the same facilitators
- A short runbook we can agree on (host handoffs, fallback model variant, and calendar invite owner)

Proposed demo slots (US / UTC offsets included):
- Option A: Thu Mar 18, 2027 — 10:30–11:30 PDT (17:30–18:30 UTC)
- Option B: Fri Mar 19, 2027 — 08:00–09:00 PDT (15:00–16:00 UTC)
- Option C: Mon Mar 22, 2027 — 13:00–14:00 PDT (20:00–21:00 UTC)

Attached an initial agenda and a one-page runbook outline for us to iterate on. Can you confirm Redwood’s host and rehearsal availability? Also — any constraints around model variant fallback (quantized vs fp16) we should bake into the runbook?

Thanks —
Ankit
Director, Partnerships — CloudBridge Systems
attachments: CB-Redwood-triage-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tri-party demo — proposed windows + agenda attached

Ankit —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the runbook starter. Looping Vanessa (partner lead) and Karthik (SI ops / marketplace) to pick the preferred slot and own preflight. Quick notes from our side:
- We can cover the technical demo from Redwood (SE + product PM). I’ll be the calendar owner unless you prefer CloudBridge to own it.
- Rehearsal: we prefer 48–72 hours before the main event. If you pick Option A or B we can run rehearsal on Tue or Wed before.
- Fallback: by default we’ll fall back to the smaller quantized variant (8-bit) only if latency spikes > 300ms p50 during the dry-run. We’ll include an explicit rollback step in the runbook.

Can you confirm which AWS SI contact (name/email) will be on the call so we can include them in invites? Also suggest we reserve an explicit 10-minute buffer for role handoffs in the runbook.

Proposed next steps:
1) CloudBridge confirms AWS SI lead and picks primary slot.
2) Redwood shares rehearsal windows and a refined runbook (I’ll attach v0.3).
3) All parties confirm calendar invite + test tokens for rehearsal.

I’ve attached a slightly revised runbook (runbook-v0.3.md). Vanessa — can you confirm host coverage for Option A/B/C and whether you want Redwood or CloudBridge to be the calendar owner?

— Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
